# Songrec

> Songrec is a mood-based music recommendation web app. Choose a vibe and popularity level to get a track from a handpicked Spotify collection.

## Public pages

- [Songrec app](https://songrec.tanujpatel.design/): choose a mood and receive a music recommendation.
- [About Songrec](https://songrec.tanujpatel.design/about/): a factual explanation of how the app works.

## Facts

- Songrec is a web application.
- Recommendations are selected from a handpicked Spotify collection.
- The app uses a mood selection and popularity slider to shape recommendations.
